purpose: This table provides one row per airport with cleaned identity, location, and classification attributes, feeding downstream analytics and joins to flight or route data keyed on airport_id.
usage: Join on airport_id (the declared grain); treat local_code, home_link, keywords, icao_code, gps_code, municipality, and elevation_ft as optionally null and filter or coalesce as needed, and use has_scheduled_service to distinguish airports with scheduled commercial service.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped entirely; local_code (63.7% null), home_link (74.9% null), and keywords (68.0% null) remain sparsely populated and were not backfilled or imputed; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
